title: True Detective Mysteries
identity_notes: Long-running true-crime anthology based on cases from True Detective Mysteries magazine. The frozen GRH subset contains 20 files representing 10 dated archive manifestations but only nine unique underlying recordings: every manifestation has a normal and 64kb encoding, and the April 1/June 12 Black Legion manifestations are the same recording reused under two dates. Local RadioGOLDINdex identifies the represented programs 1-8 as TransAmerican syndication with local commercials.

eras.notes: Reference history documents an early CBS period.

eras.label: 1936-37 transcribed/syndicated period
eras.notes: Frozen set belongs to this era; exact surviving-record evidence identifies TransAmerican syndication while broader reference histories also associate the run with Mutual.

eras.label: Mutual/sponsored middle period
eras.notes: Reference histories document later Mutual periods, including Listerine sponsorship.

eras.label: Later revival/transcribed period
eras.notes: Later surviving programs include O. Henry candy and late-1950s Mutual broadcasts.
